{"task": {"id": "I_kwDONElfw88AAAABXcfqKA", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BlV6PzhBAsbo", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BlV6P", "number": 75, "title": "Experiment with a 1/60s default Bullet fixed timestep", "body": "## Problem

[`src/animation/MMDPhysics.ts`](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/main/src/animation/MMDPhysics.ts) currently defaults `unitStep` to **`1 / 65` seconds**, with a historical comment saying that `1 / 60` appeared to break models more easily. The reason, reproduction steps, and applicability of that observation to today's implementation are not established.

The maintainer wants to **try reverting only the default fixed Bullet timestep to `1 / 60` seconds** and assess actual model behavior later. This is an experiment, **not** a confirmed solution for the intermittent severe, persistent physics instability. A fixed-step simulation remains desirable; this proposal changes the fixed interval, not the fixed-step approach.

Other MMD/Bullet implementations provide useful context: [babylon-mmd's Bullet runtime](https://github.com/noname0310/babylon-mmd/blob/main/src/Runtime/Optimized/Physics/Bind/Impl/physicsRuntime.ts) defaults to `fixedTimeStep = 1 / 60`, while [Saba](https://github.com/benikabocha/saba/blob/master/src/Saba/Model/MMD/MMDPhysics.cpp) uses a configurable fixed step with a default of `1 / 120`. These differences alone do not prove which default is most stable for this library.

## Expected outcome

Change the **default** `MMDPhysics.unitStep` from `1 / 65` to **`1 / 60` seconds** for sync and Worker physics. Preserve caller-provided `params.unitStep` overrides, including explicit `1 / 65`. Keep Bullet's fixed-timestep accumulation, positive-delta handling, and existing per-call substep budget logic.

This should be **one isolated physics behavior change**. In particular, **do not change `maxStepNum` in this issue**: raising its default from 3 to 10 is a separate experiment in [#74](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/issues/74). If #74 merges first, retain its then-current setting rather than reverting it. Do not change joint, damping, collision, solver, or animation parameters to compensate for results.

### Pre-merge acceptance criteria

- [ ] Change only the default `unitStep` value to **`1 / 60`** in `src/animation/MMDPhysics.ts`; update its JSDoc and the documented `MMDAnimationHelper.add(..., { unitStep })` default, and replace/update the historical `1 / 60` instability comment with accurate context. Keep explicit `unitStep` overrides functional (including `1 / 65`).
- [ ] Preserve `MMDPhysics._stepSimulation(delta)` behavior apart from the fixed interval: pass the real positive finite `delta` to Bullet, preserve internal fractional-time accumulation and current `Math.floor(delta / unitStep) + 1` / `maxStepNum` cap. Ensure zero, negative, and non-finite deltas do not advance physics and short frames are not forced to advance one step (as established by [#68 / PR #69](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/pull/69)).
- [ ] Add or update deterministic tests using actual Bullet/Ammo integration, rather than just verifying forwarded arguments, to check elapsed simulated time and bounded substeps at representative frame rates (30/60/120/144 FPS), including a short delta and a frame stall. Verify no unintended simulation speed-up and respect for the existing `maxStepNum` cap. Account for floating-point tolerances and retained fractional time.
- [ ] Verify the default and explicit `unitStep: 1 / 65` in relevant PMD and PMX physics fixtures, covering standalone sync, shared sync, and Worker-owned Bullet pathways as applicable. Confirm the Worker receives the selected timestep and the existing queue/coalescing policy is untouched.
- [ ] Record meaningful step-count/CPU-work implications of `1 / 60` versus `1 / 65`, noting that a longer fixed step may reduce work slightly but could degrade joint stability. Do **not** claim parity with MikuMikuDance or resolution of the intermittent violent oscillation based on automated tests alone.
- [ ] Do not alter unrelated physics behavior: [#74](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/issues/74) max-substep experiment, additional damping, linked-body collisions, `STOP_ERP = 0.475`, rigid-body types/Type-2 synchronization, IK, reset/warmup behavior, gravity, recovery heuristics, examples lighting, or rendering. No public comparison toggle or other behavioral changes.
- [ ] Run and report `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, `npm run test:browser`, `npm run build`, `npm run build:examples`, applicable local example/runtime checks, and `git diff --check`. Report exactly what was and was not verified.
- [ ] **Do not require merge-triggered GitHub Pages deployment or maintainer subjective visual/stability assessment as a pre-merge approval/merge criterion.**

### Required post-merge verification

- **PENDING until merge:** Verify the merge-triggered GitHub Pages workflow successfully publishes the merged commit; record the Actions workflow URL, final run attempt and result, and deployed commit/date. Check the published PMD, Worker Physics, and Gene Light PMX examples for asset loading and runtime errors. Re-check latest workflow attempt if a transient HTTP 503 or browser-test timeout occurs; do not report an uncompleted check as passed.
- **Optional maintainer follow-up (not a merge blocker):** Evaluate physical motion and stability on real models, especially any previous instability cases. Compare against the former `1 / 65` behavior if possible and decide whether to keep or revert the new default. Automated and Pages checks do **not** establish visual or physical parity.

## Context

- Existing default and historical comment: [`MMDPhysics.ts`](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/main/src/animation/MMDPhysics.ts#L116-L124); [helper parameter documentation](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/main/src/animation/MMDAnimationHelper.ts#L137-L141).
- `WorkerPhysicsAdapter` forwards `owner.unitStep` and `owner.maxStepNum` to the Worker; preserve this.
- Previous isolated experiments: [#68 / PR #69](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/pull/69) (correct short-delta stepping), [#70 / PR #71](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/pull/71) (additional damping), [#72 / PR #73](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/pull/73) (linked-body collisions).
- Related but **independent** work: [#74](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/issues/74) increases the maximum Bullet substeps to 10. Keep the effects of the two changes distinguishable during validation.
